title: German Hash Browns with Potato and German Sausage
description: A hearty German-inspired breakfast dish featuring crispy hash browns and savory sausage.

ingredients.name: 1 large potato
ingredients.notes: Peel the potato and grate it.

ingredients.name: 1 german sausage
ingredients.notes: Slice the sausage into 1/2-inch thick pieces.

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons hash
ingredients.notes: Use a flavored hash like paprika or garlic.

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons yellowed butter
ingredients.notes: Use a flavored butter like garlic or herbs.

ingredients.name: 1 egg
ingredients.notes: Beaten eggs add moisture to the hash browns.

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper
ingredients.notes: Season the hash browns and sausage to taste.

instructions: 2. Peel and grate the potato, then squeeze out excess moisture.
3. In a large bowl, combine the grated potato, beaten egg, salt, and pepper. Mix well to combine.
4. Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Add the potato mixture to the skillet and press down to form a flat layer.
6. Cook for 4-5 minutes, or until the bottom is golden brown.
7. Flip the hash browns over and cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, or until the other side is golden brown.
8. Meanwhile, cook the sausage in a separate skillet over medium-high heat, until browned and cooked through.
9. Serve the hash browns with the cooked sausage on top.
10. Sprinkle with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
